files.description:
Recording of city ambience near a park from my apartment window at night.

Recorded and processed at 24bit 96kHz using the Tascam DR-40 Linear PCM Recorder.

Processing: Gain-staging and soft high and low frequency filtering. No EQ boost or cuts anywhere else.
files.author: Joao_Janz

files.description: Field recording on a city street. Starts off with some power drilling noise and then cuts to regular ambience. Recorded using a Sennheiser AMBEO Smart Headset in binaural audio. not the best mic but maybe it will be of some use to you.
